name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by his grandfather's stories of working on agricultural machinery. This led him to pursue a vocational degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in metal fabrication and welding. After graduating, he joined a local racing team, where he honed his skills building and repairing chassis components. His meticulous approach and eye for detail quickly gained him a reputation for quality work. 

He joined Tolman Motorsport two years ago, and has become a valuable asset to the team. Krzysztof takes immense pride in his craft, believing that every weld, every cut, and every fitment must be executed to the highest standard. He's driven by a desire to push the boundaries of performance through precision and craftsmanship. Krzysztof's commitment to perfection and his unwavering focus make him a standout fabricator, always striving to deliver components that are not just functional, but also aesthetically pleasing.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side with a slight wave
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a stocky build, reflecting years spent working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting a project.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters that he rotates in his workspace.
